flashSizeHint: Pick the flash size that matches your board - chart above shows which chips use which size, easy.
layoutHint: Pick the board matching your HUB75 setup - chart above’s got the chip and flash size you need.
memoryTypeHint: Only matters if your board’s got PSRAM - pick the option matching its interface. Not sure, or it’s got none? Leave it on Standard, totally chill either way.
flashModeHint: Default matches whatever flash mode this release already rides with for your chip - safest choice, and you need it to match an existing bootloader when updating in place. DIO/QIO force that mode where a build’s actually out there for it - chart above’s got the details.
